relationships.subject: melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic melatonin administration resulted in a reduced TLR2 expression and NLRP3 inflammasome activation.

relationships.subject: TLR2
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, the inhibition of microglia activation ameliorated morphine tolerance via inhibiting TLR2-NLRP3 inflammasome signaling in spinal cord.

relationships.subject: TLR2
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of TLR2 suppressed the microglia and NLRP3 inflammasome activation, as well as restored the spinal melatonin level while attenuated the development of morphine tolerance.

key_findings: Morphine tolerance increased spinal TLR2 and NLRP3 inflammasome activation and lowered melatonin.
A TLR2-melatonin negative feedback loop regulates microglia and NLRP3 activation in morphine tolerance.
